description: Run a read-only tool from any allowed pack by its full name (for example hub_find_low_stock) without it being listed. Only tools that read are accepted; tools that change data run through call_write_tool. Arguments follow that tool's own input schema, which find_tools returns.

name.description: The tool's gateway name, e.g. hub_get_products or flow_list_flows.

name: call_tool
title: Run a read-only tool
